summary: Defines the CDN-Loop HTTP request header field, used to detect and stop non-terminating request loops when a request is forwarded between content delivery networks and accidentally or maliciously sent back to the first. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: If two delivery companies keep passing a package back and forth, it never arrives. This header leaves a stamp so they can notice and stop.

questions: what is the cdn-loop http header
